breakdown.description: For an ordinary passive dielectric medium, the relative permittivity should not be less than 1.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not resolve the inconsistency as demonstrated by the ground truth. The ground truth corrects the physically impossible value of relative permittivity from 0.82 to a plausible value of 8.2. The agent, however, kept the incorrect value of 0.82 and simply explained why it was incorrect. It failed to generate a corrected, physically consistent prompt.
